name: LUCIFER
full_name: Low-background Underground Cryogenic Installation For Elusive Rates
summary: LUCIFER developed scintillating bolometers for background rejection in neutrinoless double-beta-decay searches. Its enriched zinc-selenide crystal technology fed directly into the CUPID-0 demonstrator at Gran Sasso.
detection_principle: A cryogenic crystal measures particle energy as heat, while a separate light absorber records scintillation. Their relative response separates alpha particles from the electron events of interest.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: The LUCIFER crystal-development programme enabled the enriched-ZnSe CUPID-0 detector.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
